name: Fence Line
tagline: HOA software that doesn't make you hate your neighbors more than you already do
positioning: Fence Line runs violation letters, dues, and board drama for small property managers who own the whole thing and answer every angry email themselves.

hero.h1: The HOA runs itself. You just take the credit.
hero.sub: Fence Line handles the violation letters, the dues nobody wants to pay, and the meeting minutes nobody reads — so you can manage 40 communities without becoming the villain in all of them.

features.title: Violation letters, minus the writing
features.description: Snap a photo of the beige-adjacent shutters, pick the bylaw, and Fence Line mails the notice with the exact clause quoted. Certified receipts logged automatically.

features.title: Dues that collect themselves
features.description: Auto-billing, late fees, and payment plans for the guy who's been 'sending a check' since March. Delinquency reports the board actually understands.

features.title: Reserve math you can defend
features.description: Live reserve fund tracking against your study, so when someone yells 'where did the money go' at the annual meeting, you have the answer on screen.

features.title: One inbox for the chaos
features.description: Owner emails, texts, and portal messages land in a single thread per unit. No more digging through a personal Gmail account at 11pm.

features.title: Board portal that hides the mess
features.description: Give directors a clean dashboard — votes, budgets, and open items — while you keep the receipts and the audit trail behind the scenes.

features.title: Documents that don't vanish
features.description: CC&Rs, meeting minutes, and vendor contracts in one searchable vault. Find the 2019 amendment before the lawyer asks twice.

testimonials.quote: I went from 12 communities to 31 without hiring anyone. The violation letters used to eat my Fridays — now they go out while I'm in the truck.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: An owner accused us of losing $18k from the reserve. I pulled the ledger up on my phone at the meeting. The room got very quiet, very fast.
testimonials.name: Doug Reinhart

testimonials.quote: My whole business used to live in my personal inbox. Fence Line made me look like a company with a back office. I am still just me and a golden retriever.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the one-person shop running a handful of associations from a laptop.
For growing managers who stopped answering the phone personally.
For multi-manager firms with real accounting and real auditors.

homepage.footerBlurb: Fence Line is HOA management software for people who never wanted to run an HOA. Fewer letters, faster dues, quieter meetings.
